# rune-basalt (vendored)

Layr's UI theme: the `rune-basalt` crate from [Rune-Basalt](https://github.com/adamhlt/Rune-Basalt)
(`themes/basalt`), copied at commit `3eea285996049120b315c1b4848aa0bfa9519422`.

It takes `rune`, `rune-kit` and `rune-theme-opencode` from Layr's workspace (`{ workspace = true }`),
so it always builds against the Rune revision Layr pins. To update it, copy `themes/basalt` again
and note the new commit here.

GPL-3.0-or-later (see `LICENSE`); the bundled fonts keep their SIL OFL licences in `assets/fonts/`.
